subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core Control UI/Gateway batch dictation feature that records browser microphone clips and routes them through `tools.media.audio`, or fold this back into the broader WebChat voice plan?
rationale: The code path is feasible but crosses UI, Gateway authorization, provider routing, local temp-file handling, and microphone privacy boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent product shape while an open closing PR is under review.

options.title: Review the linked Gateway-backed dictation PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide the narrow batch-dictation implementation through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027, with proof and security/provider review before merge.

options.title: Fold into the broad voice tracker
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 as the canonical tracker and close or retarget the narrow PR if maintainers want a unified STT/TTS WebChat design first.

options.title: Reject core dictation for now
options.body: Keep Control UI voice input limited to existing Talk and attachment paths until a plugin/API or broader UX direction is approved.

recommendation.title: Review the linked Gateway-backed dictation PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide the narrow batch-dictation implementation through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027, with proof and security/provider review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the earlier merged server-side dictation work and is the strongest available history signal for the same Control UI/Gateway voice boundary.
